name: LuxTTS
summary: Lightweight text-to-speech model for 48kHz voice cloning, reaching 150x realtime in under 1GB of VRAM.
description: A ZipVoice-based TTS model and Python code for cloning a voice from a short reference clip and generating 48kHz speech. Runs locally, on Colab or Hugging Face Spaces, on GPU or CPU; community builds add Gradio, ComfyUI and ONNX front-ends.
contains: voice cloning from a 3+ second reference clip
48kHz speech output (typical TTS models cap at 24kHz)
150x realtime on one GPU, faster than realtime on CPU
ZipVoice architecture distilled to 4 sampling steps
community apps: Gradio, ComfyUI, ONNX and hosted demos
